why: The second half of 2026-10-03-youtube-channels. The YouTube chat confirmed five channel names (Chris, 3 October 2026): AI 4 All, AI for Teachers, Pascal School SA, Java School SA, SQL School SA. This request adds the avatar art and banner backgrounds for SQL School SA and AI for Teachers, plus a plain end-card background for every channel. The end card is 1920 x 1080; YouTube's own elements (2 videos, a subscribe circle) go over the left and middle, so the detail stays at the edges. Board: https://claude.ai/artifact/LtgVBNvwsQKPhcxTb9feYz. Colours: SQL deep green #0e3b2a and mint #6fe3a5; AI for Teachers warm red #c8372d, white and gold #ffd166.
style: No text, no letters, no numbers, no words, no logos anywhere.
